name: D.Western Therapeutics Institute, Inc.
summary: D. Western Therapeutics Institute, Inc. is a biotechnology company that researches and discovers drugs. Its products include GLANATEC and GLA-ALPHA, eye drops for glaucoma and ocular hypertension, DW-1001 for eye conditions, DWR-2206, a cell-based regenerative product for bullous keratopathy, and DW-1002, a surgical aid for staining membranes during cataract operations.
